main_body: white/grey rectangular bathtub basin filled with blue water on small gold feet
top_band: rows 3-10: light grey/white horizontal tub rim framing a recessed blue water opening (rows 5-9) with a front rim edge at row 10
evidence: Reading down a central column: rows 3-4 form the back rim, rows 5-9 show the recessed interior opening filled with water (row 5 darker blue inner wall/shadow, rows 6-9 light blue water), row 10 is the light front rim edge, and rows 11-15 form the vertical front face of the tub basin and its feet set back under the overhanging rim.

style.evidence: While the grey/white porcelain ramp uses 5 lightness steps and a muted grey outline, the surfaces are composed of sterile, completely flat horizontal colour bands: the water is a 22x4 flat fill of a single blue (with only a 2px corner highlight) and the rim and front wall are long uniform strips with no grain, ripple, or surface variation compared to the richly textured Beodeul well and stall.
